title: Rex's Star Snacks
description: Help Rex the T-Rex subtract fractions with the same denominator by taking away star-shaped snacks!
topic: Subtracting fractions with the same denominator
objectives: Subtract fractions with the same denominator
Understand that the denominator stays the same during subtraction

character.name: Rex
character.description: A small smiling dinosaur with orange spikes and a round green face.

phrases.thinking: Look closely at the equal pieces.
phrases.encourage: Good try! Let's look at the pieces again.

slides.title: Rex is Hungry
slides.story: Rex the T-Rex has a pan of delicious star snacks cut into equal pieces. Let's help Rex subtract fractions as he eats some snacks!
slides.objective: Subtract fractions that have the same denominator.
slides.readAloud: Rex the T Rex has a pan of delicious star snacks cut into equal pieces. Let's help Rex subtract fractions as he eats some snacks!

slides.instruction: Rex starts with 4/5 of a star snack pan. He eats 1/5. What fraction is left?
slides.supportingText: The pan is split into 5 equal pieces.
slides.secondHint: The bottom number 5 stays the same.
slides.explanation: 4/5 minus 1/5 equals 3/5. The denominator stays 5 because the piece sizes do not change.
slides.readAloud: Rex starts with 4 fifths of a star snack pan. He eats 1 fifth. What fraction is left?

interaction.prompt: Rex starts with 4/5 of a star snack pan. He eats 1/5. What fraction is left?

slides.supportingText: You can type a fraction or a decimal.
slides.explanation: 5 sixths minus 2 sixths is 3 sixths. The denominator stays 6.
slides.readAloud: Type the result of 5 sixth minus 2 sixths. You can type a fraction or a decimal.

slides.supportingText: The marks are evenly spaced fourths.
slides.hint: Start at 4/4 and hop backward 3 steps.
slides.secondHint: You will land on the first mark after zero.
slides.explanation: 4/4 minus 3/4 equals 1/4. That is the mark one fourth of the way from 0 to 1.
slides.readAloud: Tap the mark that shows 4 fourths minus 3 fourths. The marks are evenly spaced fourths.

slides.instruction: Rex has 7/8 of a star pan and gives away 3/8. Shade the remaining pieces to show 7/8 - 3/8.
slides.supportingText: Shade the correct number of segments.
slides.hint: Start with 7 shaded pieces and remove 3.
slides.explanation: 7 eighths minus 3 eighths leaves 4 eighths shaded.
slides.readAloud: Rex has 7 eighths of a star pan and gives away 3 eighths. Shade the remaining pieces to show 7 eighths minus 3 eighths.

interaction.prompt: Shade the remaining pieces to show 7/8 - 3/8.

slides.supportingText: Look at the remaining shaded pieces.
slides.hint: Subtract 6 minus 4 on the top numbers.
slides.explanation: 6 tenths minus 4 tenths is 2 tenths. The denominator stays 10.
slides.readAloud: Which fraction shows 6 tenths minus 4 tenths?

slides.title: Snack Time Success!
slides.message: Rex is full and happy! You mastered subtracting fractions with the same denominator.
slides.conceptSummary: When subtracting fractions with the same denominator, subtract the numerators and keep the denominator the same.
slides.readAloud: Snack time success! Rex is full and happy! You mastered subtracting fractions with the same denominator. When subtracting fractions with the same denominator, subtract the numerators and keep the denominator the same.
